== English Virtual Original Objective comparison ==
The full 10 June 2003 PC announcement immediately replaces the reverse and leaves the early front unchanged; August and February reaffirm it. Incoming non-exempt loss stays capped at 1 in the middle, and the opponent loss now excludes 1st Marker and requires a speeder and a Rebel. The 2006 reverse reduces incoming loss by occupied Hoth locations to a minimum of 1 and specifies a T-47 and Rebel. The 2006 front changes starting locations, makes T-47 Battle Formation an Out Of Play Interrupt with Sense immunity, and changes the pull from once per turn to own deploy phase. The old 1st Marker and later Main Power Generators are two names for the same Hoth site. Keep both faces per state. Both issuer-hosted 2007 images match the relevant final paper face.
